verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms a live llms.txt at developer.woocommerce.com that indexes all WooCommerce documentation files. An agent can be pointed at it directly. First-party MCP docs add further agent-oriented material. missing for 10: evidence of llms-full.txt or per-page markdown variants, independent or hands-on corroboration of how well agents consume the file.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
